description: CANONICAL SOURCE for the bar-odd S-leak anchor values S = c_3 + Vol(4_1), which QOU/QBeta/SLeakZeroCrossing.lean, MonodromyDatumRigidity.lean and CompleteStructureExclusion.lean cite and which at least four Python probes had hand-copied as bare 6-digit literals. This probe previously emitted NO witness, so there was nothing to read instead — the copies were the only carrier. It also computed in float64 despite 12-digit string inputs. Both fixed: mpmath throughout, and the values are published here with the digit count the c_3 + Vol(4_1) cancellation actually supports. Derives nothing new; it is the same computation, sourced.

precision.why: S = c_3 + Vol(4_1) subtracts two quantities agreeing to their first two digits, so S carries fewer significant figures than its inputs. Reporting S at the inputs' 12 digits would be fake precision; the 6-digit literal the consumers copied is the opposite error.

sign_flip.scope: the zero-crossing is an INFERENCE from continuity (IVT), and the fraction is a linear-interpolation estimate of its location, not a computed q*
